feature: Laporan ad hoc HST: Hirer/Driver Furnished dan Alternative Address Furnished (GET /v1/hst/reports/hirer-driver-furnished dan /alternative-address)
note: Dua endpoint GET di ocmsadminapi mengembalikan record furnish untuk ID HST (hirer/driver, serta eService/LTA) per rentang tanggal. Tidak ada story di chunk OCMS20.26-20.28 yang menyebutnya dan tidak ditemukan pemanggil di ocmsadminui; endpoint ini mengembalikan JSON, bukan file. Cakupan story lain (jika ada) belum dicek.
note_en: Two GET endpoints in ocmsadminapi return furnish records for HST IDs (hirer/driver, and eService/LTA) by date range. No story in the OCMS20.26-20.28 chunk mentions them and no caller was found in ocmsadminui; the endpoints return JSON, not a file. Coverage by another story (if any) was not checked.

feature: Manual HST Update: halaman staff dan endpoint update-hst untuk mengubah nama/alamat baris HST dan nama di ONOD semua notice ID itu
note: Layar /hst/update memanggil POST update-hst yang mengubah baris ocms_hst dan nama offender di ONOD (alamat notice tidak diubah). Tidak ada story di chunk OCMS20.26-20.28 yang menamai perilaku ini; mungkin dicakup story OCMS20 lain.
note_en: The /hst/update screen calls POST update-hst, which changes the ocms_hst row and the offender name in ONOD (notice addresses are not changed). No story in the OCMS20.26-20.28 chunk names this behaviour; it may be covered by another OCMS20 story.

feature: Job Monthly HST Report (Excel 10 kolom dari ocms_hst + TS-HST) dengan trigger manual POST /v1/hst/report/execute, tidak masuk jadwal
note: HstReportServiceImpl.executeJob membuat MonthlyHSTReport_yyyyMM.xlsx dan upload ke blob, hanya bisa dipicu manual lewat controller; tidak ada pemanggil di scheduler Daily/Monthly. Berbeda dari rantai laporan alamat OCMS20.27 (Data Report dan Work Items Report). Tidak diklaim untuk story ini.
note_en: HstReportServiceImpl.executeJob builds MonthlyHSTReport_yyyyMM.xlsx and uploads it to blob, and can only be triggered manually through the controller; no Daily/Monthly scheduler calls it. It differs from the OCMS20.27 address report chain (Data Report and Work Items Report). Not claimed for this story.
